title: fix(app-shell): a new report from an app's reports list saves into the app's package, as a new view does
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ
Fixes #37261

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：管理员在应用的报表列表里点「新建」做的报表，以后会和在同一个应用里新建的视图存到同一个地方。可写的应用存进应用自己的包；已安装（只读）的应用存进它的定制包。所以 Studio 的报表列表能看到这些报表。已有的报表不搬动。
- 为什么做：属于 Studio 重构专题。从 Studio 打开的新建报表已经按这条规则存，这次让应用自己的「新建」入口也用同一条规则，两条路不再各做各的。
- 出错会怎样：新报表可能落在错误的包里，或不属于任何包，这时 Studio 列表里看不到它。改动只影响以后新建的报表，撤回这次改动即恢复原来的做法。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

- `ReportNewPage`'s save no longer makes the package lookup depend on `studioReturn`. Both entry points call `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage(appPackageId, 'report')`:
  - Studio's report list;
  - the New button on the app's own reports index.

  When that call names a package, the report saves through `saveAndPublishInPackage`. The package is the app's own when it is writable; otherwise it is the `.custom` pair, created through the ensure door.
- When the call answers `null`, the report is saved with no package through `saveAndPublishRuntimeMetadata`. That happens when the package is not listed, the ensure door refuses, or the door answers with a pair that is not writable. It is the same condition under which `createRuntimeMetadata` falls back for a view (`app?.packageId && !packageId`).
- The `report.builder.savedOutsideApp` notice used to show only from Studio. It now shows on the no-package fallback from either entry point. Its text ("…so the Studio list does not show it") is true for both, so no string changes.
- `resolveRuntimeCreatePackage`'s console warning already names the type being saved; #36906 did that.
- Existing reports are not moved. Only the target of a new report's first save changes.

## Tests

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportNewPage-36692.test.tsx` gains a new top-level describe, *the app's own New saves into the app's package, as a new view does (objectstack#37261)*, with three pins:

- **writable package:** a new report from an app on a writable package names `packageId: P`.
- **read-only app:** on an installed (read-only) app, it names the `P.custom` pair.
- **CONTROL:** when the ensure door refuses (403), the report saves with no package, shows `report.builder.savedOutsideApp`, and the warning names `report`.

**Replaced pin:** *Save creates and publishes the report and lands on its page; nothing speaks of a menu*. Its assertions that the report saves with no package outside Studio are removed. It now asserts one save and one publish.

Run at `9ded3000`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 16 passed (16)`.

<details><summary>Ablations (scripts/ablation-replace.mjs; restored blob == HEAD)</summary>

- A1, the old `studioReturn` gate put back: 4 failed | 12 passed.
- A2, the notice limited to Studio again: 1 failed | 15 passed.
- A3, the fallback removed: 2 failed | 14 passed.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Done-when: a report made from any app's New lands in the same package a view made there would, and Studio's report list shows it.
  - The package is resolved by the same function as for a view, with the same `draftBarPackageOf` input as `useRuntimeCreateApp`.
  - The fallback condition is the same expression as `createRuntimeMetadata`'s.
- No route change, and no change to how existing reports are stored.

## Verification

Two-minute check: in an app on a writable package, open Reports, click New, pick a data source and save. The report should then appear in Studio's report list for that package.
